fact: The Higher Education (Use of Artificial Intelligence) Regulations 2026 (GN No. 39 of 2026), made on 3 April 2026 under the Higher Education Act 2017, came into operation on 31 March 2026 and apply to AI use in the higher education sector.
title: Higher Education (Use of Artificial Intelligence) Regulations 2026
publisher: Government Gazette of Mauritius No. 25 (Higher Education Commission copy)
